label: http api • memory or disk prefix reuse after prefix-sharing requests
query: Summarize in one sentence: a lighthouse keeper walks the same spiral staircase every evening at dusk to light the lamp.
notes: Two successful prefix-sharing chat requests over real HTTP must produce content and increase memory prefix_hits or disk_l2_hits. Rotating and recurrent cache topologies restore prefixes through v2 disk payloads, so both counters are reported separately. A flat result across both tiers fails. Off-CI (needs a local cache-enabled model).
